FIX blank game preview: extractClassName/hasClassDeclaration were imported but never inlined into the generated runtime, so every exported game died with 'extractClassName is not defined' and Play showed a blank window. Also adds a static used-but-not-defined checker for the runtime.

FIX blank game Play window (definitive): script-source helpers are now inlined from a dedicated no-transform scriptSourceInline.js instead of being imported, so the generated runtime defines extractClassName/hasClassDeclaration itself. Previously every exported game died with 'extractClassName is not defined'. Adds a used-but-not-defined runtime checker and a deterministic preview test hook.

FIX blank game Play window: the generated runtime now inlines its own extractClassName/hasClassDeclaration/fitSunShadow instead of relying on module-scope imports, which threw 'extractClassName is not defined' and left every exported game blank. Also strips ESM exports from inlined shadowFit (a SyntaxError in the generated script). Adds an execution-based runtime regression test and a deterministic Play test hook.

Diagnostics for the Play path: adds a guard-bypassing preview hook that returns the build log, so a failing preview build is diagnosable instead of silent. Includes the blank-Play fix from 194 (inlined runtime helpers).

Add a build-only probe hook that returns the FULL BuildResult, so a failing game preview is diagnosable. Previously a failure printed 'no HTML output' even when the error list was empty, hiding the cause. Includes the blank-Play runtime-helper fix.

FIX blank Play for the RTS templates: RtsCore declared RtsContent twice (colliding with the core script) so the game failed to compile, and the unit prelude emitted a literal backslash-n instead of a newline. Red Alert and StarCraft now build and start. Adds scripts/validate-rts-scripts.mjs which reconstructs and syntax-checks every emitted script.

FIX blank Play (root cause): applying a game template appended scripts instead of replacing them, so stale broken script copies stayed in the project and every build failed. Project scripts had grown to 499 for 184 objects. addScript is now idempotent by name and applyTemplate clears the previous template's scripts first.

FIX RTS runtime errors: the shared Rts namespace was only published inside RtsCoreSetup.start(), so units, buildings and the AI ran their first updates against an undefined namespace and threw every frame. The namespace is now published at module scope, before any script can tick.

FIX RTS runtime errors: the shared Rts/RtsContent namespaces are now resolved through globalThis at each use instead of being snapshotted into a const at script-evaluation time. Script evaluation order is not guaranteed, so the captured binding could be permanently undefined, throwing once per frame in every unit, building, AI and player update.

FIX blank Play for the MMO templates (World of Warcraft and Aion 2): MmoCore declared MmoContent twice, colliding with the core script, so the game failed to compile. Namespaces now resolve through globalThis at each use and are published at module scope. Same class of fix already applied to the RTS templates. Adds scripts/validate-mmo-scripts.mjs.

Real terrain + real assets. Terrain now uses ridged multifractal noise with domain warping and erosion-weighted octaves, replacing plain fBm that produced smooth blobs; the old height function also returned exactly 0 inside the play radius, making the whole playable area a flat plane. Adds a verified CC0 (public domain) GLB model catalogue so templates can use authored models instead of primitives.

Terrain visuals: fix fog that buried the world (fog began at playRadius*2.2 ~= 369 units in a 940-unit world, so all ground beyond it faded to a dark fog colour and the foreground rendered black). Terrain now uses MeshStandardMaterial with a normal map derived from the height field (adds surface detail with zero extra triangles) at 360 segments. SSAO enabled in game presets - it was fully implemented but intensity was 0. Fixes a TypeScript annotation and a named-export list that both broke the generated runtime.

Fix the black RTS view: the game camera was never positioned. It sat at the world origin with a zero direction vector because Camera.follow only lerps toward its target and there were two competing camera objects. The RTS command camera is now set deterministically at match start (elevated, pitched down at the base), and the duplicate camera object is removed.

Fix the large black slab covering the terrain: the sun's shadow bias was tuned for a 60-unit shadow frustum but the view-following fit widens it to 160, so the bias became far too small and the terrain self-shadowed (shadow acne). Bias and normalBias now scale with shadow texel size. Also includes the FPS core module for the new first-person template family.

Remove the dark ground slab covering the RTS play area. Diagnosed by elimination: it was not the terrain (hiding __terrain changed nothing), not shadows (disabling all shadow casting changed nothing) and not post-processing (bypassing it revealed the true cause) - it was a hand-placed dungeonfloor box whose dark grid rendered on top of terrain that already exists, with a hard edge at ~163 units in a 760-unit world.

Fix black terrain: the detail texture was tiled 108 times across the world (repeat = size/7), so every pixel sampled below one texel, the mip chain resolved to the texture average and the multiply collapsed the surface to black. Found by measuring the terrain: vertex colours were healthy (mean luminance 0.786, zero near-black) so the colour data was fine and the MATERIAL was destroying it. Tiling is now anchored to 24 world units per repeat.

FIX all games rendering too dark: the shadow bias I introduced to cure acne was unbounded and produced -0.036, about 100x the useful range, which flips the shadow depth comparison so surfaces compare as fully shadowed and the world goes nearly black. Bias is now clamped to a working range. This is a global lighting fix, so it applies to every game template at once.

Fix flickering graphics and smooth the image: (1) shadow focus now snaps to the shadow texel grid, so shadows stop crawling and sparking as the camera moves, with the sun position recomputed from the snapped focus so the light direction cannot wobble; (2) anisotropic filtering plus mipmaps on the generated terrain detail and normal maps, which were previously sampled at full resolution at every distance - the classic cause of ground shimmer; normal-map tiling reduced and strength eased from 1.35 to 0.85. Applies to every game template.

Brighten all four flagship games: ambient and hemisphere light were too low to read the terrain (Star Command had ambient 0.4 and hemi 0.62 against a very dark sci-fi sky). Red Alert, Star Command, Azeroth Reborn and Aether Ascendant now use ambient 0.95-1.05 and hemisphere 1.35-1.5 with lighter ambient colours. Also raises the sky and ground hemisphere tints so terrain reads at distance.

Fix Star Command and Aether Ascendant rendering near-black: the alien biome palette was itself very dark (ground #3e2a5a, rock #3a2e4a, mountains #4a3a6a), so the terrain was textured correctly but nearly invisible against the dark sci-fi sky. Palette lifted to readable mid-tones (ground #8a6ab8, rock #8a7ab0, mountains #9a8ac8) and the snow line lowered so peaks catch light. Red Alert was unaffected because its desert biome is already bright.

Fix all flagship games: rebuild terrain so ridged mountains actually generate (size/warp scale bugs put the whole mountain ring outside the mesh), unpin blown-out auto-exposure, soften depth-of-field, raise near-plane for depth precision, fix SSAO buffer, god rays opt-in
flagship games deep pass: terrain follow + slope limits, Aion free flight, MMO jump, class-mesh rebuild, rigged creature anims, wind sway, placement fixes

terrain/world graphics: curvature AO baked into vertex colours, irregular rock strata, macro patchiness, forest-floor tint, shoreline foam + depth-tinted water via baked heightmap, soft smooth clouds, terrain-conforming contact shadows under scatter
RuneScape full-game template + runtime boot-order fix (item defs/shops/quests ready before scripts start), tools wieldable, trout fishing, banner fixes, QA globals
night mode lighting fix: moonlit readability floor, sun→moon dimming, cool hemisphere wash, lifted night sky/fog palette
Elderwild full-game rewrite: walled village + 8 POIs + crypt dungeon, 10 Kiln GLB landmarks, 9 quests, bosses, mount, crafting, save/load

Elderwild gap-fix pass: terrain snap + flats (285 floaters fixed), terrain-following player/mobs, crypt sealed (17m walls, wide floor/ceiling, room clamp for player+camera+mobs), crypt lighting 30+, hero lantern, night stars in sky shader, damage-flash no longer blurs screen, H-key controls overlay

Game Studio: 962-model CC0/MIT asset catalog (KayKit dungeon/city/rigged chars, Kenney kits), remote GLB/GLTF proxy loading, Poly Pizza live search, Kiln Forge AI mode + KILN_ASSET directive, gltf bundle export embedding
Kiln engine main-process IPC (status/render/validate/discover/verify/read-glb) — activates the Kiln Forge AI mode and KILN_ASSET directive shipped in patch 219

Rigging+animation pipeline: RIG_ASSET/GENERATE_ANIMATION directives, multi-mesh segment-weighted rigger, pivot binding (Kiln Joint_*), 8 procedural clips baked to GLB, bone alias retargeting (Mixamo/KayKit), UniRig+UniMate IPC/install-on-demand, engine status UI
